# Array callback integer result

Owned static consumers retain one exact formal array, one complete unary
callback and an opaque integer result, with optional scalar context. Original
varargs declarations still consume the same fixed array. Source and SDK-provider
profiles preserve metadata, array identity/covariance, callback order, partial
writes and exact late failures. Four frozen routes cover two public wrappers;
six wrong programs and six Code-preserving Signature controls guard the proof.
